body: Yes, this is indeed an issue. We'll take a look.

https://github.com/google/ExoPlayer/commit/93f4a19f07939bb3cdf606f69142f8de527735f7?diff=unified#diff-f7126640f9a9b7a13981cd10d12aadeaR363

This might be the culprit. There is no url added to audio list if `isMediaTagMuxed` returns true.

That's the change that introduced this issue, yes. However that change was also fixing something else. The correct way to resolve this is probably to have ExoPlayer's `HlsMasterPlaylist` more directly represent what the playlist file contains, and move the logic for interpreting it (e.g. whether a media tag is muxed) into `HlsMediaPeriod`.

issue.title: HLS: Chunkless Preparation breaks certain byte-ranged HLS content

repository.name: ExoPlayer
repository.description: This project is deprecated and stale. The latest ExoPlayer code is available in https://github.com/androidx/media

issue.body:
### Issue description

Testing byte-ranged HLS content(fMP4 or TS) with the chunkless preparation feature turned on, the player fails to initialise the content and throws a `player failed` error, To confirm that the content is valid and not the culprit here, we turned off chunkless preparation and re-ran the test, the content played as expected.

### Reproduction steps

- Get the ExoPlayer demo application:
  - `git clone https://github.com/google/ExoPlayer.git.`
  - checkout to latest tagged release `git checkout tags/r2.9.6`
  - open the demo app found in `demo/main` under the HLS section.

- Turn on chunkless preparation:
  - In `PlayerActivity` under `buildMediaSource` add `.setAllowChunklessPreparation(true)` to the HlsMediaSource.Factory() function.
  - Add the test content in the `media.exolist.json` file found under `demo/assets`:
    - Add 
    ```
    {
    "name": "test content",
    "uri":  <use the URI emailed to dev.exoplayer@gmail.com>
    }
    ```
    under the HLS section.

- Play the video.
  - execute the demo app 
  - choose the HLS drop down from the menu list.
  - select the video titled "test content"

You will observe that the video playback fails.

- Now setAllowChunklessPreparation(false) and run again, you will observe the video plays successfully.

### Link to test content

Link to the test content has been emailed to dev.exoplayer@gmail.com under the subject line "issue #NUMBER". 

### A full bug report captured from the device

bug report sent to dev.exoplayer@gmail.com using subject "Issue #NUMBER".

### Version of ExoPlayer being used

ExoPlayer version 2.9.6

### Device(s) and version(s) of Android being used
- LG G6 Android version 7
- LG G6 Android version 8
- Pixel 2 XL Emulator version 9

body:
A short explanation to external readers: 

The issue here is that the playlist parser is marking audio some EXT-X-MEDIA tags as multiplexed because they match one of the audio-only variants. Audio-only variants are discarded during preparation when there are also non-audio-only variants in the playlist. Audio-only among non-audio-only variants are discarded because ExoPlayer does not support disabling tracks (video in this case) as a means of adapting.
This will be fixed in 2.10 because we reverted the change that introduced the issue.
